scope: Methodological check of declared noncircular moving-block test; not a new return hypothesis or rescue analysis
null_centering: Original paired active return array minus its observed mean; contiguous resampling. Algebraically identical to resampling then subtracting observed mean.
interpretation: Centering arithmetic is correct. Noncircular blocks downweight endpoint months, producing finite-sample bootstrap bias. Percentile intervals and null-centered tests therefore need not be dual. Preserve both reported outputs; five-test-adjusted significance fails. No changed block length, circular bootstrap, or neighbor selection used to rescue the candidate.
